elements.requirement: The office of Domestic Abuse Commissioner is inserted at the appropriate place in Part 3 of Schedule 1 to the House of Commons Disqualification Act 1975 as an office disqualifying for membership.
elements.quote: In Part 3 of Schedule 1 to the House of Commons Disqualification Act 1975 (offices disqualifying for membership), at the appropriate place insert— “ Domestic Abuse Commissioner. ”

elements.requirement: The office of The Domestic Abuse Commissioner is inserted at the appropriate place in Part 6 of Schedule 1 to the Freedom of Information Act 2000.
elements.quote: In Part 6 of Schedule 1 to the Freedom of Information Act 2000 (other public bodies and offices: general), at the appropriate place insert— “ The Domestic Abuse Commissioner. ”

elements.requirement: Subsection (1) of section 37 of the Government of Wales Act 2006 applies to actions taken by the Domestic Abuse Commissioner pursuant to section 7(4)(b) or (c) of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 in the same manner as it applies to the exercise of functions by the Welsh Ministers.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) applies in relation to things done by the Domestic Abuse Commissioner by virtue of section 7(4)(b) or (c) of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 (functions exercisable in relation to devolved Welsh authorities etc) as it applies in relation to the exercise by the Welsh Ministers of their functions.
